summary.text: Wayne Rogers is the Democratic nominee, an attorney who has practiced in Alabama since 1988 and, since 2019, has worked as executive assistant to the Jefferson County sheriff. He lists ending straight-ticket voting, adopting early voting and letting absentee voters fix ballot defects as his key messages.

paragraphs.text: Native of Thomasville who has lived in Birmingham for 45 years; litigator who appeared in 66 of Alabama's 67 counties.
Serves on boards of mental-health entities and on the national board of Crisis Intervention Team International.
